verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents its own CLI command for launching the server with a model (`local-ai run ...`) and describes itself as one binary serving an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost:8080, which covers the start half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents a CLI stop, shutdown or daemon-management command. missing for 10: documented CLI stop/shutdown command, background/daemon start-stop lifecycle management, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it.
PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
